title: CommitmentClaim.v1
description: A typed financial commitment (e.g. revenue guidance) frozen in the YUCLAW v8 workbench. Every comparability field is explicit and mandatory; amounts are integers or decimal strings in the stated unit (floats are refused); the enforcing validator is v8/workbench/schema.py. Research and education only. Not investment advice.

unit.description: measurement unit; for money it equals `currency`

scale_as_stated.description: presentation scale of the source text; amounts are always stored in units

amount.description: exact decimal; JSON floats are refused

accession.description: EDGAR accession for kind=filing; otherwise an EDGAR accession or a publisher identifier PREFIX:publisher:id

available_as_of.description: when the source became publicly available (EDGAR acceptance); never the local action time

excerpt.description: exact passage; rendered as inert text, never executed

source_hash.description: sha256 of the excerpt bytes; binds bytes, not publisher authenticity

rights.description: only FICTIONAL and SEC_PUBLIC_FILING excerpts are bundled into an export; COMPANY_PRESS_RELEASE and UNKNOWN keep the digest only

outcome.description: yuclaw-commitment-outcome/1 (validated by the same module): schema, claim_id, metric, actual (amount), unit, currency, basis, fiscal_period (period), comparable (boolean declaration; the calculator re-checks every field), source, fictional
